evidence.quote: it needs to be done on Guerilla's not Chained Kong's in the volcano

evidence.quote: Found in Forest Maze, after leaving the first cave.

subject: Forest Maze secret area
text: The correct path through the Forest Maze to the secret area is left, left, straight, right.

evidence.quote: The correct path is left, left, straight, right

subject: Forest Maze secret area
text: Left and right in the maze directions are from Mario's perspective.

evidence.quote: You have to walk from Mario's perspective

subject: Forest Maze secret area
text: Done correctly, you end up facing the same way as the starting left path.

evidence.quote: if done right you will basically turn to the same way that you started ie the left path

subject: Green Star Piece
text: Under RetroArch, use the snes9x core; the Bsnes Mercury core caused this achievement not to unlock.

evidence.quote: use snes9x if you are using Retroarch. I used the core Bsnes Mercury and I had issues with it not unlocking

subject: Green Star Piece
text: Players who already beat the game can use the Flikki to get credit for the achievement.

evidence.quote: use your Flikki to get credit for the achievement

subject: Progression achievements
text: Copy the save file to a backup folder right after each progression achievement unlock so a save exists just before each one.

evidence.quote: Right after each progression achievement unlock you can go to the save folder and copy it to backup folder

subject: Forest Maze
text: The later part of the Forest Maze is hard because you must follow a guide while dodging flying enemies, and you may lose track of the path when he is no longer visible.

evidence.quote: Had hard time following him while dodging the flying enemies efficiently.
Then kept guessing the wrong path when he wasn't visible anymore.

subject: Link
requires: Defeat Bowyer in the Forest Maze
text: Link appears when you sleep at the Rosetown inn after beating Bowyer in the Forest Maze.

evidence.quote: He appears when you sleep in the inn of Rosetown after you beat Bowyer in the Forest Maze.

subject: Goomba Thumping
text: After about every 10 points the game pauses to reset every pipe, then spawns Goombas faster.

evidence.quote: After every 10 (?) points, the game pauses to reset every pipe, then spawns them faster.

subject: Goomba Thumping
text: At the 30 point pause, stand on the same pipe and hope to bop a Goomba all 5 times.

evidence.quote: Once you get to the 30 point pause, just stand on the same pipe, hoping that you bop a goomba all 5 times.

subject: Goomba Thumping
text: Pick only two directions (such as left and right) and focus on those pipes, since the isometric view makes precise movement hard.

evidence.quote: instead of going for all the different directions pick two (in my case left and right) and focus on only those pipes.

subject: Goomba Thumping
text: Hit detection is strict: you must be in jump frames almost perfectly over the Goomba or it does not count.

evidence.quote: If you're not in jump frames almost perfectly over the top of the Goomba then it doesn't count.

subject: Goomba Thumping
text: Gold Goomba spawns are random and help the score.

evidence.quote: Pray to RNGesus that you get good Gold Goomba spawns.

subject: Goomba Thumping
text: One player reported scoring exactly 35 without the achievement unlocking.

evidence.quote: I get exactly 35 and not unlock for me

evidence.quote: Press: B,B..A,A for a good pace. Use a cookie (using Y) if you're getting stuck

subject: Yo'ster Isle race

subject: Yo'ster Isle race
